title: Universal computation square of a normalized section scalar comparison
statement: Let a:Λ→Λ′ be a morphism of commutative condensed coefficient rings and T a scheme, with the internal scalar functors and their universal computation maps of [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]. Supply a section scalar comparison s satisfying SectionScalarNormalized a T s, with its specified ordinary and derived comparison isomorphisms and scalar-derived pair [def-sfb-internal-section-scalar-pullback-comparison-data]. Then for every internal cochain complex P, without any flatness assumption on P or its terms, the realized internal scalar computation map followed by the localization and ordinary comparison maps equals s.derived at QP followed by s.pair.derived of the localization comparison and the section scalar computation counit at the section image of P. This is the scalar computation equation of SectionScalarNormalized with both flatness hypotheses removed, written using the canonical cochain composition isomorphisms on both sides of the ordinary comparison.

source.place: Tags 03EK, 06YS, 06YY, 0D6D and 07A6; normalization transport, endpoint universal computation step.

proof.text: Resolve the section image by a flat-term K-flat complex. Lift it and its augmentation through the termwise section equivalence. Its counit transfers K-flatness and termwise flatness; exactness and full faithfulness reflect the quasi-isomorphism.
Form the two natural transformations on internal complexes whose components are the two paths in the scalar normalization equation.
Apply the given scalar normalization at the lifted resolution. Naturality of the two paths along its augmentation gives the equality at P, cancelling the invertible localized augmentation.

proof_origin.place: Explicit scalar/pullback section-transport calculation, using the specified universal counits and adjunctions.

theorem section_scalar_computation_all (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a] (T : Scheme.{u})
    (s : SectionScalarComparison a T) (h : SectionScalarNormalized a T s)
    (P : CochainComplex (Modules Λ T) ℤ) :
    @Eq ((ModuleRingedComparison.derivedEquivalence Λ' T).functor.obj
      ((D a T).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((s.pair.extension.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence Λ T).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          P)))
      ((ModuleRingedComparison.derivedEquivalence Λ' T).functor.map (compute a T P) ≫
        (ModuleRingedComparison.sectionLocalizationComparison Λ' T
          (((extension a T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)).hom ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso s.ordinary (.up ℤ) ≪≫
          (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (Iso.refl
            ((ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence Λ T).functor ⋙ s.pair.extension))
            (.up ℤ)).symm).hom.app P))
      (s.derived.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        s.pair.derived.map (ModuleRingedComparison.sectionLocalizationComparison Λ T P).hom ≫
        SheafOfModules.scalarPairComplexComparison.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
          s.pair.extension s.pair.extension_additive s.pair.derived s.pair.counit
          (((ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence Λ T).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
            P))
